summary: Platinenwerk Lausitz GmbH, privately owned PCBA maker (320 staff); we are 0.72 % of its turnover; it is our sole source for the smart-pump control board. It asks +8.0 % (34.35 to 37.10), citing copper and electronics; notice was on time. It has sold below full cost for four years to keep the volume (should-cost 37.24). Concede part of the increase, but use its poor quality and our volume.
notes: Needs volume; it fears losing the part. Quality is weak: 21 complaints in three years, ppm up to 701, two open 8D, OTD 84-92 %. We pay late (40.6 % of invoices over 5 days), though it has not complained yet. Squeezing below its cost is risky with no second source.

evidence.quote: accepted below full cost to keep the volume
price changes above 2 % need the approval of their pricing committee, which meets every two weeks.
40.6 % of invoices paid over 5 days late

avoid: copper or electronics index arguments (they rose)
threatening a second source we do not have
claiming a notice breach (letter on time)
tactics: Open moderately, at or just above 34.35; it is below cost and we have no second source.
Lead with the quality record: open 8D reports, rising ppm and 21 complaints.
Offer a binding annual volume; it has always traded price to keep the volume.
Aim to settle below its 2 % committee threshold (about 35.0).
playbook.expected_concession: No arena data; history shows it settles well below its ask (last year asked 2.1 %, settled 0.4 %), so expect it to give up most of the 8 %.
